ngxChat.name: ngx-open-web-ui-chat
ngxChat.description: npm component for AI chat integration in Angular applications
ngxChat.detailedDescription:
ngx-open-web-ui-chat is a powerful Angular component that seamlessly integrates AI chat functionality into your web applications. Built specifically for Angular developers, this component provides a ready-to-use chat interface that connects directly with Open WebUI, enabling sophisticated AI-powered conversations without the complexity of building chat UI from scratch.

The component offers extensive customization options, allowing developers to tailor the chat experience to match their application's design language. With support for modern Angular features and TypeScript, it ensures type safety and excellent developer experience. The component handles message rendering, user input, and real-time communication with AI models efficiently.

Integration is straightforward - simply install the package via npm, import the module into your Angular application, and configure the connection to your Open WebUI instance. The component manages state internally, reducing boilerplate code and letting you focus on building features rather than infrastructure.

Perfect for applications requiring AI assistance, customer support chatbots, or interactive AI-powered features, ngx-open-web-ui-chat provides a production-ready solution. It supports streaming responses, markdown rendering, and handles edge cases gracefully, ensuring a smooth user experience.

The package is actively maintained and follows Angular best practices, making it a reliable choice for both small projects and enterprise applications. Whether you're building a customer service portal, an AI assistant interface, or any application that needs conversational AI, this component accelerates development while maintaining code quality.

accountingAI.name: Accounting AI Agent
accountingAI.description: AI assistant for accounting work in Poland
accountingAI.detailedDescription:
Accounting AI Agent is an intelligent assistant specifically designed for accounting professionals and business owners in Poland. This innovative solution combines artificial intelligence with deep knowledge of Polish tax law, accounting regulations, and business practices to provide accurate, reliable support for daily accounting tasks.

The system seamlessly integrates with wFirma, one of Poland's leading online accounting platforms, enabling automatic data synchronization and real-time access to your financial documents. This integration eliminates manual data entry, reduces errors, and ensures that the AI assistant always works with up-to-date information about your business operations.

Whether you need help understanding complex VAT regulations, calculating PIT or CIT obligations, or navigating ZUS (Social Insurance Institution) requirements, the AI agent provides clear, actionable answers. It can analyze your invoices, suggest optimal tax strategies, and help ensure compliance with Polish accounting standards and regulations.

The assistant goes beyond simple question-answering - it actively helps manage your accounting workflow. From invoice processing and categorization to automated calculations and financial reporting, it handles routine tasks efficiently while maintaining accuracy. This allows accountants and business owners to focus on strategic decisions rather than repetitive administrative work.

Built with security and privacy in mind, the system ensures that your sensitive financial data remains protected. The AI agent is continuously updated with the latest changes in Polish tax law and accounting regulations, providing you with current, reliable information. Whether you're a small business owner managing your own books or an accounting professional serving multiple clients, this AI assistant streamlines your workflow and enhances productivity.

emarketingAI.name: Marketing AI assistant
emarketingAI.description: AI-powered marketing automation platform for content creation, campaigns, email marketing, and analytics
emarketingAI.detailedDescription:
eMarketing AI is an AI-powered marketing automation SaaS platform that helps create content, manage campaigns, send emails, and analyze results — all in one place. The platform leverages advanced AI models to generate customized marketing materials tailored to your brand voice and target audience.

The platform offers comprehensive AI content generation supporting social media posts, blog articles, emails, newsletters, ad copy, and landing pages. Users can configure content type, platform, topic, keywords, tone, and length. Content follows a structured workflow from Draft through Review to Approved and Published status.

Campaign management allows planning and tracking across email, social media, blogs, and multi-channel strategies. The built-in email marketing system includes SMTP and Resend API integration, subscriber management with personalization placeholders, and pre-built templates for quick start.

The interactive AI Chat Assistant provides real-time marketing guidance — from strategy questions and content ideas to SEO guidance, email assistance, and campaign planning. It works in English, Polish, and Russian, adapting to your project context for more relevant suggestions.

Additional features include AI-generated task checklists for product launches, weekly tasks, and campaign preparation. The document generation system creates marketing plans, reports, competitive analyses, brand guidelines, content calendars, and proposals in structured format. The analytics dashboard tracks impressions, email opens, clicks, and conversions with trend analysis.

The platform supports team collaboration with role-based access (Owner, Admin, Member) and offers flexible subscription plans: FREE with 50 AI generations/month, PRO with 500 generations and up to 5 team members, and ENTERPRISE with unlimited resources. New accounts receive a 14-day free trial without requiring payment information.

features.contentGeneration: AI content generation for social posts, blogs, emails, and ads
features.emailMarketing: Full email marketing with subscriber management
features.aiChat: Interactive AI chat assistant for marketing strategy

budgetAssistant.name: AI Budget Assistant
budgetAssistant.description: Smart financial companion for tracking expenses by voice, receipt scanning, or manually
budgetAssistant.detailedDescription:
AI Budget Assistant is your smart financial companion that transforms personal finance management into a simple and engaging process. The app combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with an intuitive mobile interface, allowing you to track expenses manually, by voice, or by scanning receipts using AI-powered OCR. Support for seven languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian) makes the app accessible to users worldwide.

The app supports multi-currency budget management simultaneously — USD, EUR, PLN, GBP, UAH with real-time exchange rates. The built-in AI chat powered by GPT-4 lets you ask questions about your finances in natural language and receive personalized advice. Artificial intelligence analyzes your spending, suggests expense categories, extracts data from receipt photos, and generates insights about your financial habits.

Create budgets with spending limits and track progress in real-time with automatic notifications when approaching limits. Interactive analytics provides detailed charts with drill-down capabilities, category breakdowns, and trend analysis. AI generates narrative "Spending Stories" reports — engaging stories about your spending with achievements and insights, turning dry numbers into understandable narratives.

AI Budget Assistant supports multiple account types — Personal, Shared, and Business with role-based access (Owner, Editor, Viewer). This allows you to manage family budgets together with family members or track team expenses. Each participant receives an appropriate access level, ensuring security and convenience in collaborative financial planning.

The app motivates you to maintain financial discipline through a gamification system — earn achievements, maintain daily streaks, gain experience points (XP), level up, and collect badges for consistent financial tracking. Offline-first architecture ensures data is saved locally and automatically synced when online, allowing you to work with the app in any conditions.

features.aiChat: AI chat with GPT-4 for financial advice
features.expenseTracking: Voice input, receipt scanning, and manual entry

testingAI.name: Testing AI Assistant
testingAI.description: AI-powered test orchestration platform for automated test execution, generation, and quality assurance
testingAI.detailedDescription:
Testing AI Assistant is an intelligent test orchestration platform that revolutionizes how teams approach software quality assurance. By combining artificial intelligence with modern testing practices, this platform automates test execution, generates test cases, and provides comprehensive quality insights — all from a single, unified interface.

The platform features AI-powered test generation that analyzes your codebase and automatically creates meaningful test cases covering edge cases, boundary conditions, and critical user flows. Whether you're working with unit tests, integration tests, or end-to-end scenarios, the AI agent understands your application's architecture and generates tests that provide real value.

Test execution is fully orchestrated with intelligent scheduling, parallel execution, and smart retry logic. The platform manages your test suites efficiently, prioritizing tests based on code changes and historical failure patterns. Real-time dashboards provide visibility into test progress, results, and trends across your entire testing pipeline.

Built-in checklist management helps teams maintain testing discipline. Create and track quality checklists for releases, sprint reviews, and feature validations. AI-generated checklists adapt to your project's specific needs, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks during critical releases.

The notification system keeps your team informed with real-time alerts on test failures, quality regressions, and milestone completions. Integrate with your existing communication tools to ensure the right people are notified at the right time.

AI agents work continuously in the background, monitoring code changes, identifying areas that need additional test coverage, and suggesting improvements to your testing strategy. The platform learns from your project's history to provide increasingly accurate and relevant recommendations over time.

features.testExecution: Orchestrated test execution with intelligent scheduling and parallel runs
features.testGeneration: AI-powered test case generation from codebase analysis
features.checklists: Quality checklists for releases and sprint reviews
features.notifications: Real-time notifications on test results and quality metrics
features.aiAgents: AI agents for continuous test monitoring and coverage analysis
